$comment: This dependency list is a second copy of cesium-native's, which applies its own platform guards in its CMakeLists rather than in its manifest. Anything upstream excludes or narrows for a platform has to be excluded or narrowed here too, or the guard has no effect. curl and cpp-httplib are unusable in a browser. blend2d's jit feature needs a JIT that wasm and iOS do not have. ktx takes default-features:false because the port enables its 'js' feature by default on emscripten, and those JavaScript wrappers do not compile against Emscripten 3.1.56's embind; upstream asks for ktx[core] for the same reason, and on native platforms the port has no default features at all so this costs nothing there. When bumping cesium-native, diff its CMakeLists PACKAGES_PRIVATE block against this list.
